verdict.rationale: Gram is a SaaS AI control plane, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis, but the pack never documents registrable HTTP callbacks for event subscription. The nearest items are 'configure telemetry delivery' via the platform MCP and exportable tool-call records; both are adjacent features, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can subscribe to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
